mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reduces the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the cost of capital decreases.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS below 3.0% for 3 consecutive months and 20-day forward returns negative in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 0.2 percentage points in a month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as recession fears increase.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises >0.2pp in 1 month and 20-day forward returns positive in more than 60% of such cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a broad-based economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market anticipates reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: HOUST and INDPRO both decline by more than 1.0% in the same month and 20-day forward returns positive in more than 60% of such months.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, high consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals an impending monetary policy tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the central bank raises interest rates.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions (UNRATE < 4.0% and GDPC1 quarterly growth > 3.0%), CPIAUCSL annualized inflation rate > 3.0% and 20-day forward returns negative in <=40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Strong payroll employment growth (PAYEMS) signals a healthy labor market and robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as corporate earnings prospects improve.
failure_condition: PAYEMS growth above 0.5% in a month and 5-day forward returns negative in more than 60% of such months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 2.0% in a month signals a weakening housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the broader economy faces headwinds.
failure_condition: HOUST falls >2.0% in a month and 60-day forward returns positive in more than 60% of such months.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in retail sales (RSAFS) combined with a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates a dual shock of weak consumer demand and monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in reduced economic activity.
failure_condition: RSAFS declines >0.5% and FEDFUNDS rises >0.25pp in the same month and 20-day forward returns positive in more than 60% of such months.

mechanism_narrative: In low unemployment expansions, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a manufacturing slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the market anticipates reduced corporate profits.
failure_condition: In low unemployment expansions (UNRATE < 4.0%), INDPRO declines >0.5% in a month and 5-day forward returns positive in more than 60% of such months.
